prompt: Our customers are demanding full Scope 3 and supplier ESG data. What can they actually require from us, and what must we produce ourselves?
assertions: Distinguishes the asker's own reporting duties (if in scope) from data requests cascading down the value chain
Applies the value-chain cap: requests to ≤1,000-employee partners are capped at the voluntary standard's (Reg. 2026/1560) content
Covers Scope 3 reporting expectations under the revised ESRS for in-scope reporters (GHG categories, estimation/proxies where primary data is unavailable)
Advises practical responses: voluntary-standard-aligned data package, estimation methodologies, phased supplier engagement
Mentions transition reliefs/phase-ins where relevant rather than asserting maximal obligations
